description: Load-Climate-Open: an open hourly dataset and reproducible pipeline for day-ahead electricity-load forecasting with climate and renewable-generation features, published by Titov, Vladyslav, combines German load, climate and renewable-generation features for a thesis-related forecasting benchmark. Coverage: German zone observations during 2015-2019, explicitly substituting for non-redistributable Ukrainian thesis data. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The supplied data represent Germany, not Ukraine. Claimed forecast metrics are limited to the stated chronological split. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
